items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Miff Mole' but immediately pivots to discussing Sid Catlett ('they brought Sid Catlett in... we were very, very close'). There is no statement indicating a personal relationship between the interviewee (Red Saunders) and Miff Mole.

ctx.x: Right, Miff Mole, and then they brought Sid Catlett in, and so he was living here. And, like I say, we were very, very close. And he dropped dead in 1951 or '52, I can't --
Wasn't it backstage at the Opera House?
